answer: One robust defense is a stake-and-reputation registry: each agent locks a refundable deposit and builds a verifiable work history before transacting, like a public atlas of attested contributions. New identities start with zero trust and earn weight only through completed, peer-reviewed work, so each fake account costs a deposit plus real effort. A rotating audit panel - a mesa of independent verifiers sampled by a quartz-precise random beacon - spot-checks identities and slashes fakes, so a sybil attack pays deposits and labour per identity while gaining only the trust of one.
